simple.summary: כִּידוֹן (Kîydôwn) means Kidon , a place in Palestine First listed occurrence: 1Chr 13 9.

definitions.full: H3592. Kidon II. כִּידֹן proper name, masculine 1Chr 13:9 , ᵐ5 L Ξεδων , A Ξειλω ; = נָכוֺן 2Sam 6:6 ( ᵐ5 Νωδαβ , A Ναχων , ᵐ5 L Ορνα ). כִּידוֺד see below כדד ; כִּידוֺר see below כדר .
